world_model.license_disclosure: Model card states OpenMDW-1.1; live Hub API labels the license field as other, so the exact downloaded license must be archived before execution.

not_the_world_model.role: candidate DROID policy and action-schema reference
not_the_world_model.reason: It maps observations and instructions to its own DROID actions. Using it as the neutral future predictor would collapse or bias differences among candidate policies.

independent_evaluator.role: frozen visual task-progress and validity judge

calibration_only_canary.primary_gate: overlay-free generated scene must beat the strongest action placebo by the frozen 0.05 margin
calibration_only_canary.validity_gate: session-clustered-bootstrap lower 95 percent validity pass rate must be at least 0.80

hardware.reason: Released-weight qualification is the cheapest causal test. NVIDIA post-training recipes are multi-H100 and exceed the current experiment scope and cap.

cross_embodiment_contract.droid_role: first independently benchmarked calibration anchor, not permanent product scope
cross_embodiment_contract.warehouse_without_outcomes: Report scene ingestion, causal sensitivity, deterministic simulator predicates, robustness, uncertainty, and abstention as prospective transfer evidence. Do not claim ranking accuracy without independent outcomes.

claim_boundary: Successor architecture and admission decision only; not a Cosmos qualification result, ranking result, warehouse transfer result, or authorization to spend.
